title: Senior HR Recruiter, Oil and Gas/Energy Sector
description:
Jereh Energy Equipment and Technologies is seeking a Human Resource Recruiter with a strong focus on talent acquisition to support recruitment and onboarding efforts across the Oil & Gas, Energy, and Manufacturing sectors. This role will play a critical part in attracting, hiring, and retaining top talent while ensuring compliance with industry-specific labor regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

· Lead full-cycle recruitment efforts for technical and corporate roles, including engineering, field operations, sales, procurement, and accounting.
· Utilize LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and Boolean search techniques to source top talent.
· Develop targeted recruitment strategies for Oil & Gas, Energy, and Manufacturing professionals, ensuring alignment with business needs.
· Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements and build proactive talent pipelines for future needs.
· Ensure compliance with labor laws and industry-specific hiring regulations across Oil & Gas, Energy, and Manufacturing operations.
· Drive employer branding initiatives through job fairs, industry networking, and social media recruitment efforts.
· Enhance the onboarding experience to improve employee retention and engagement.
· Provide general HR support, including policy communication, employee relations, and benefits coordination as needed.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
· 3+ years of experience in recruitment and HR, preferably in Oil & Gas, Energy, or Manufacturing.
· Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, etc.).
· Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and industrial equipment roles to identify qualified candidates.
· Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple hiring projects simultaneously.
· Experience collaborating with diverse teams and working with field-based and corporate employees.

Please send your resume to —
careers@jereh.com

title: Global Supply Chain Director
description:
As the Supply Chain Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive supply chain strategies, including global procurement, logistics, inventory control, and supplier relationship management. You’ll lead a cross-functional team and ensure seamless collaboration across engineering, finance, and operations to support the delivery of complex energy equipment systems. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong background in integrated oilfield services or turbine manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities:

· Lead end-to-end supply chain operations across procurement, logistics, inventory, and vendor management
· Develop strategic sourcing plans aligned with company growth goals
· Drive cost reduction, process improvement, and operational efficiency
· Partner with engineering, operations, and finance to align supply chain strategies with product delivery
· Build and maintain strong supplier and customer relationships
· Ensure compliance with ESG standards, corporate policies, and industry regulations
· Mentor and manage a high-performing, multicultural supply chain team

Qualifications:

· Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred)
· 10+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience
· Experience managing procurement and logistics in oilfield services, power systems, or turbine/genset manufacturing
· Proven success in supplier negotiations and large-scale project execution
· Strong ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle) and data analysis skills
· Fluent in English (Spanish bilingual preferred)

Please send your resume to —
careers@jereh.com

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
Jereh Energy Equipment and Technologies is seeking a Sales Support Specialist with a strong background in sales operations, contract fulfillment, and internal coordination within the energy equipment or industrial systems space. This individual will serve as the operational anchor supporting the entire order-to-delivery process, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment across teams.
Candidates with experience supporting complex equipment orders, technical project coordination, or multi-stage contract execution are highly encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

Contract and Order Management
· Accurately enter and manage sales orders and contracts in ERP and CRM platforms.
· Coordinate with sales and internal departments to ensure timely contract approvals.
· Monitor fulfillment status, analyze delivery timelines, and provide performance reporting.
· Manage visibility across the entire contract lifecycle from production through payment.
Execution Support and Coordination
· Lead internal contract handoff processes to project management and operations.
· Interpret customer requirements and technical specifications to ensure successful execution.
· Support field milestones such as CAT events, invoicing, and change management.
Documentation and Compliance
· Maintain structured digital and physical records of contracts and fulfillment documents.
· Monitor the consistent use of standardized documentation formats and templates.
· Prepare shipment documentation, including bills of lading, packing lists, and invoices.
Sales Support
· Assist with internal sales coordination efforts, customer visit logistics, and reporting.
· Provide process support to enhance team effectiveness and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field; equivalent experience accepted.
· At least 2 years of experience in inside sales, sales support, or contract management within industrial or energy-related sectors.
· Bilingual in Mandarin and English (Required)
· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and working knowledge of CRM and ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Salesforce).
· Strong ability to interpret technical data, sales agreements, and project specifications.
· Demonstrated organizational accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to manage cross-functional priorities.

Please send your resume to —
careers@jereh.com

title: Sr. Account Manager – NexGen Frac & Mobile Power Solutions
description:
This is more than a sales role—this is a market leadership opportunity. The selected candidate will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key clients, positioning JEET as their go-to partner for electric frac equipment, mobile gas turbine solutions, and critical field support systems. You’ll combine technical fluency with commercial savvy to open doors, close deals, and fuel JEET’s growth in the completion and energy transition space.

Key Responsibilities:

· Serve as the primary relationship lead for major operators and service providers utilizing electric or hybrid completion systems.
· Sell JEET’s E-Fleet systems, mobile turbine power plants, electric-driven components, sand conveyors, blenders, and related aftermarket parts.
· Lead consultative sales efforts—guiding clients through technical specs, deployment needs, and integration with existing fleets.
· Drive full-cycle sales: prospecting, presenting, proposing, negotiating, and closing.
· Develop and execute account growth plans with a focus on long-term partnerships, fleet expansion, and product customization.
· Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams to tailor configurations that meet the unique demands of U.S. shale operations.
· Maintain all sales activity in Salesforce CRM, including pipeline tracking, client notes, and forecasted revenue.
· Attend and represent JEET at industry events, client demos, and technical summits to strengthen our brand presence.

Qualifications:

· 5–10 years in technical sales or account management for oilfield equipment—completion systems, electric frac equipment, or mobile power preferred.
· Demonstrated success in selling to E&P operators, completions teams, or major oilfield service providers.
· Deep familiarity with E-Frac fleets, gensets, mobile turbines, and related power control or distribution systems.
· Technical proficiency in equipment specifications, field deployment, and system compatibility.
· Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
· Proficient in CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and account planning.
· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or equivalent work experience.

Please send your resume to —
careers@jereh.com

title: Director of Engineering
description:
We are seeking an accomplished Director of Engineering to lead our North American engineering division. This strategic role involves driving product innovation, managing cross-functional teams, and overseeing the full product development lifecycle—from R&D through commercialization. The Director will play a key role in aligning engineering operations with Jereh EET’s mission of delivering high-impact, ESG-driven solutions to the upstream oil & gas sector.

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Strategy
· Lead the engineering department with a focus on collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
· Set and implement engineering strategies aligned with Jereh’s business goals and ESG commitments.
· Define departmental objectives and manage timelines, KPIs, and performance metrics.
Product Development & Innovation
· Oversee the development of new oilfield products and technologies that meet market demands and regulatory compliance.
· Guide the engineering lifecycle, including concept design, prototyping, validation, and commercialization.
· Drive continuous improvement through collaboration with sales, marketing, quality, and manufacturing teams.
Client-Facing Engagement
· Utilize at least 5 years of experience engaging directly with oil & gas clients to deliver tailored engineering solutions.
· Present and explain complex technical products to client stakeholders, including field operators and executives.
· Support business development efforts through technical presentations and solution-selling.
Team Management
· Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of engineers and technical staff.
· Manage department budgets, headcount planning, project schedules, and technical resources.
· Build a performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and development.
Cross-Functional Communication
· Foster strong relationships with internal departments and external partners including suppliers and regulatory entities.
· Ensure seamless communication across engineering, operations, quality, and compliance teams to align on project goals.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field; Master’s or advanced degree preferred.
· 10+ years of engineering experience in the oil & gas sector, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
· Deep familiarity with upstream oilfield technologies including completions and fracturing equipment.
· Proven track record with companies such as Baker Hughes, Halliburton, NOV, Nextier, or similar.
· Experience managing technical teams through full-cycle product development.
· Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
· Demonstrated alignment with ESG principles and sustainable engineering practices.
· Problem-Solver: Ability to manage multiple complex projects and implement innovative engineering solutions.

Please send your resume to —
careers@jereh.com
